lines.text: An electric guitar, guys, an electric guitar, yeah. We're giving out an electric guitar today. The stakes are really high. Are you guys ready to play round one?

lines.speaker: voice-over
lines.text: Round one is a buzzer round called True Story, where each question is based on an actual news article. Let's play.

lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: All right. The Chhattisgarh High Court recently upheld a family court order granting a divorce to a man whose wife insulted him by calling him dash just because he refused to leave his parents. What did she call him? I have multiple choice questions, but if you want to go

lines.speaker: Jose Covaco
lines.text: Oh, I don't need the multiple choice. Yes, she called him laudu.

lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: Plus twenty. Plus twenty. Wow. That came from a very personal place, Jose.

notes: Score call is 'plus twenty' by game logic (host awards points); several systems wrote 'Class 20'. Name 'laudu' (Hindi slang) variants: Laudu/Loudu/laddu.
